svg.title: A source packet replaces the gavel
svg.desc: Center the source packet on the table in place of a gavel. Authority in this forum comes from examined evidence rather than judicial spectacle. Keep the paper-fragment perimeter and four empty wall bays visible as invented staging, with no official chamber insignia.
